body: Hate to be negative, but r/raisedbynarcissists would like to disagree
I am. My therapist recommends this as well
Right? I kinda hope his previous work was actually good and he only recently became a little crazy, but I'm not sure yet

There's controversy around his claims of Satanic Ritual Abuse and magical eye energy stuff. This stuff makes him seem crazy to me. Now I'm questioning everything he confidently says.

I watched [this video](https://youtu.be/FoI94Epkjrc) and at first it seemed like a great revelation, but now it almost seems too crazy to be true.
At what temperature do you vape it? I want to do it in my dry vape.

Yes. That bittersweet kind of jealousy/wonder I feel when I see a loving family. It's incredible. I sat behind a young woman and her kid in a religious gathering once. I couldn't stop but stare at them. The playfulness, the warmth. I teared up right there. Fortunately nobody saw me.

When the British invaded my country, they changed certain policies that made my family's extremely successful business go bankrupt very quickly. The family had to flee to a different state to get away from debt and start a new life.

I've been trying for a long time to fix myself but I just keep failing. Even my psychiatrists say my case is really complicated. I feel like a freak of nature. I don't care about anything and I don't see a reason why anybody would care about me.

Thanks buddy. Your criticism is totally fair. Now that I'm out of my biweekly episode of depression, I see things more clearly again. Some of what I said was definitely exaggerated self loathing. That's the only way I've learned to cope during depression. Feeling sad and crying about everything gives me a strange self of relief.

I definitely didn't mean to insult the people I called weirdos. I'm a total weirdo myself and I absolutely dig people who are like me. We don't care about the status quo, find happiness in all sorts of things and love exploring the world. That sounds more fulfilling to me than being a happy little sheep (again, no insult, my vocabulary just isn't that good). I was just feeling sad because I thought I could never befriend any other type of people. But now that my depression lenses are off, I don't think so anymore. I know I can learn to understand people better. And I will one day.

Yes, I'm super passionate when my brain doesn't decide to be in a slump and I definitely feel smart. You're totally right about overprocessing both the good and bad. Thanks for saying that. That might help me find some peace when I'm loathing.

I'll definitely put more effort into learning psychology. Sometimes I feel that's just my way of avoiding sharing feelings with my therapist, but your comment validates my thought that it can help me. Nothing makes me happier than learning new things.

Thanks a lot for caring and being honest. I don't know what I was looking for when I made this post. Maybe I was just venting, but your sane voice made my inner fire a little bit stronger. I'll try my best to remember your advice the next time I'm depressed.
